rulesQuestions: Are wages paid from net-after-sponsor or before sponsor share? Bible says net is after taxes before wages — wage timing vs profitability tests is ambiguous for 'profitable' definition.
Does convoy Capacity equal route Capacity or a separate transport rating? Prep example uses convoy 100 vs route Capacity 80.
exploits: Forage can outpace Supply consumption on Tier I Mapped routes, making Supply tension weak unless complications tax Supply.
Priority-1 bulk salvage is a 'dump valve' that makes Extraction Failures feel costless when high-priority lots are safe.
recommendations: Add a profitability definition to the expedition charter: profit after sponsor+wages+repairs vs gross extraction value.
Cap Forage output by biome and require exposed risk, or Supply will rarely threaten Mapped Tier I runs.
Require at least one mid-priority lot so Extraction Failures create real choice rather than discarding junk.
